control.description-key: Header approval-process bar for book_stateswap. Renders four chevrons (State A, State B, BE, Approved) with role-gated Approve buttons per stage and a Deny button on any active stage. Denial writes book_denied=true; SwapDenialPlugin resets the state approvals so the drafter can revise. All role checks (State Approver / State Administrator / Checkbook Administrator for state approvals; Budget Executor / Checkbook Administrator for BE; any approver for deny) are mirrored in SwapValidator as the authoritative security boundary.
